title: Async TTL cache request coalescing and invalidation
evaluation_goal: Measure whether a model can implement correct asynchronous single-flight caching across TTL, rejection and invalidation races in a dependency-free JavaScript module.
candidate_visible_requirements: Cache fulfilled values per key with an exact TTL boundary measured from fulfillment.
Coalesce concurrent same-key misses while keeping different keys independent.
Cache undefined but never cache rejection or synchronous loader failure.
Prevent invalidated in-flight results from repopulating the cache without cancelling their existing callers.
Apply clear to settled entries and every in-flight key.
Preserve validation and the public API without adding dependencies.

artifact_contract.transport_normalization: The marker-delimiting newline is replaced by exactly one canonical final newline in each installed file.

verification_layers.success: The response contains only one or two complete-file envelopes with unique normalized paths.
Every submitted path is an existing allowed source module; tests and package metadata remain byte-identical.
The controller installs exact candidate file content plus the declared canonical final newline into a disposable baseline copy.
All four candidate-visible Node tests pass.
All eight candidate-hidden checks for validation, values, keys, fulfillment-time TTL, failure cleanup and invalidation races pass.

primary_outcome.name: verified_success
primary_outcome.note: No universal composite score is assigned. Diagnostic test counts are not interpreted as fractional semantic quality.
